title: HelixDB: a graph-vector database for knowledge graphs and AI memory

sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Building an AI app today means duct taping three databases together. Postgress for your data, Pine Cone for vectors, and a graph DB for relationships. Then babysitting all three. Helix DB collapses that into one. It's an open- source OLTP graph vector database built from scratch in Rust with graph traversal, vector search, and its own strongly typed query language, Helix QL, in a single engine.
